name: Findings for the Explorer's League
summary: Loremaster Dibbs asks you to carry his I'lalai tablet translations to Historian Karnik in Ironforge. Karnik sees the discovery as a reason to send a team toward the lost city.

sections.title: A Letter to Ironforge
sections.body: Historian Karnik is Loremaster Dibbs' colleague at the Explorer's League in Ironforge. Dibbs has made a discovery he calls significant to history, and asks you to carry his letter and a copy of his translations of the I'lalai tablets to Karnik.

sections.title: Karnik's Response
sections.body: Karnik welcomes Dibbs' translations and says he will gather a team to seek the lost city of I'lalai. His own studies concern other subjects, but he respects Dibbs' interest in trolls.

faq.q: Who is asking me to carry the letter?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs asks you to take his letter and a copy of his I'lalai tablet translations to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
Historian Karnik is the Explorer's League colleague in Ironforge who receives Loremaster Dibbs' letter and translations.
They are Loremaster Dibbs' translations of tablets connected to I'lalai.

faq.q: Why does Dibbs want me to take the letter?
faq.answer: Dibbs says the discovery is of great historical importance and wants his colleague in Ironforge informed promptly.

attribution: In-game quest text: Findings for the Explorer's League
